title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text: 1.Calls for the establishment of a European Day in Remembrance of the Victims of Accidents at Work and for the Protection and Dignity of Workers, to be marked each year on 28 April to coincide with the ILO World Day for Safety and Health at Work, in memory of historic tragedies such as the tragedy at the Bois du Cazier mine in Marcinelle, which, owing to its intrinsically European nature – in that it involved workers from several countries that are now Member States of the EU – represents a common symbol of the struggles for decent work and the need for a common approach to the protection of health and safety at work; / 1.
